== Biography ==
[[Glasgow-1141|Alexander Glasgow (bef.1695-)]] has children 1721-1732 in Kirknewton. From this we can assume circa 1703. Fathers match based on location/name/timing. 

== Research Notes ==
=== Father confidence review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1314]] is assessed at 34% (possible). Alexander-1314’s1673 Kirknewton childhood and1701/1705 marriages put an adult Alexander in the right parish and generation for Alexander-1141, father with Margaret Moultrie in1721–1732. The c1703 son estimate falls between those marriages. Local continuity and compatible generation support the existing proposal, but no own-childhood source names Alexander-1141’s father and the estimate may have been constructed from the same pedigree.

Possible34% for the proposed father, with mother unassigned by this review. The children’s1721–1732 baptisms establish the younger adult’s household, not his own father.

Next useful test: Check the existing Kirknewton1701–1705 household gap for the younger Alexander rather than extend earlier ancestry first.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-JYR "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-JYR : 12 February 2020), Alexander Glasgow in entry for Margaret Glasgow, 1721.]. No new original was inspected in this review. This is an assessment of an existing attachment, not a new father.

=== John Glasgow's 1727 baptism, reviewed 24 October 2026 ===

Two Findmypast derivative transcripts describe one baptism: John Glasgow, male, baptised 14 February 1727 at Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, son of Alexander Glasgow and Margaret Mutrie. One also indexes the family's residence as Kirknewton. The named father and child match [[Glasgow-1343|John]] in Alexander's maintained 1721–1732 household; the existing father assessment for that child remains 97% (proved). The transcripts give birth year 1727 but no exact birth date. Margaret is the recorded mother; the equation with the current [[Moultrie-158]] profile remains unassessed. These are companion indexes for one event, not independent original corroboration. Alexander's own proposed father [[Glasgow-1314]] remains a separate 34% (possible) assessment; this child entry does not establish Alexander's ancestry.<ref name="FMP20John1727A">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686209974&tab=this R_686209974], derivative transcript captured 24 October 2026; original register uninspected.</ref><ref name="FMP20John1727B">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691906011&tab=this R_691906011], companion derivative transcript captured 24 October 2026; original register uninspected.</ref>
